<function name="SetClipboardText" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Adds the given string to the computers clipboard, which can then be pasted in or outside of GMod with Ctrl + V.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="text" type="string">The text to add to the clipboard.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Sets the clipboards text to "Hello!".</description>
	<code>SetClipboardText( "Hello!" )</code>

</example>
